description: This file defines a final class `WatchReplyCoordinator` responsible for managing watch reply events, including deduplication, queuing when the gateway is disconnected, and forwarding decisions.

classes.name: WatchReplyCoordinator
classes.description: A class that manages watch reply events, handles deduplication, queuing, and forwarding logic.

methods.name: ingest
methods.description: Processes an incoming watch reply event, deduplicates, queues if disconnected, or forwards.

methods.name: drainIfConnected
methods.description: Returns queued events if the gateway is connected, clearing the queue.

methods.name: requeueFront
methods.description: Re-inserts an event at the front of the queue.

methods.name: queuedCount
methods.description: Returns the number of queued reply events.
